intro_html: Oregano and dill seasoned beef over rice with a thick swipe of hummus, cool yogurt, crisp cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and salty feta. Every bowl delivers 38 grams of protein for about $2.93. It eats like the fast casual Mediterranean chains, without the line or the upcharges.
cost_closing_html: About $2.93 a bowl for what the Mediterranean bowl chains charge $13 to build, and they still ask if you want to add protein for $4 more.
shop_smart: The 93/7 beef is $21.60 of this batch, more than half the bill. When the 4 lb pack goes on sale, that is the week to make this one.
Cherry tomatoes ran $5.12 here. If the clamshells are not on sale, diced roma tomatoes do the same job for about half the money.
Feta is the sneaky line at $4.63. The crumbled tubs charge you for convenience; a block of feta crumbles in ten seconds and usually costs less per ounce.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice: rinse it, then simmer covered with water until tender and set it aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet, add the ground beef, and break it up as it browns. Cook until no pink remains.
Season the beef with the garlic powder, dried oregano, dried dill, salt, and black pepper, and let it toast in the spices for 2 minutes.
While the beef cooks, dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and slice the red onion thin.
Build each container: rice on the bottom, seasoned beef, a scoop of hummus, a scoop of Greek yogurt, then cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and crumbled feta.
Portion evenly across 14 containers. Keep the yogurt and hummus to one side of the box if you plan to reheat, then stir them in after.
portion_html: Weigh the pot of rice and the pan of beef, subtract the empty pot number, and divide each by 14 so every container gets an even share. Each finished bowl comes out to about 568 calories and 38 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Hearty dinners for about $2.93 a bowl. This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.

steps: Cook the rice and set it aside.
Brown the ground beef in olive oil, then season with garlic powder, oregano, dill, salt, and pepper.
Dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, and slice the red onion.
Layer rice, beef, hummus, Greek yogurt, fresh vegetables, and feta into 14 containers.
